full_judgment: 2. The prosecution case, in short, is, that a but standing on plot No. 384 of Mouza Pikepara under Tangibari PS which was a subject matter of Tangibari PS case No. 3 (10) 86 was given under Jimma of one Rustum Mataber, the complainant; the value of the but was Tk. 20,000.00. The accused petitioners forming an unlawful assembly on 16.10.86 being armed with lethal weapons namely, lathi, axe, etc. forcibly dismantled and took away the said but in spite of protest of the complainant. Upon such accusations the complainant filed the application to the Upzila Magistrate who directed the Officer-in-Charge of Tangibari PS to inquire into the matter. The Investigating Officer submitted his report after holding enquiry. Thereafter charge sheet was submitted against the petitioners under sections 143/447/379 of the Penal Code.
